images.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.

Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

Recipe: establish. One single landscape location key, exactly 1536x1024 PNG, full detailed environment. High camera 15 m above the flooded floor near the nave entrance, looking gently down the full length with tall vault included; one coherent perspective. Named key light: pale daylight through visibly broken windows of very pale desaturated blue, cream and pink glass in purely abstract geometric patterns, never people or religious figures. Slate-blue water, grey limestone, cool violet-grey shadows, tarnished bronze accents. Top calm zone is the distant vault, not a blank white band.
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: drowned_cathedral/key.png for chapters 16-21. A vast ruined Far Side Gothic cathedral nave, 60 m long and 30 m to the pointed rib vault. Ten bays recede between two rows of enormous limestone pillars. The central aisle and side aisles have knee-deep still dark water; beyond the pillar rows, recessed side chapels lie lower and have chest-deep water. A few whole wooden pews float at tilted angles, separated so the layout remains clear. Silent aged bronze bells of differing large sizes hang vertically on sturdy chains from the vault, immobile, never glowing. Side passages branch at the middle bays, a left-side passage descends into the flooded crypt. At the far end, CLOSED tall bronze double doors sit beneath a large rose window of pale abstract glass, and one bronze bell hangs above those doors; below that bell and just above the doors is a tiny red iron warning lamp. Doors are about 5 m high, rose window around 6 m diameter, architectural details correctly scaled. Render readable deep architectural depth, all chains actually attached to vault ribs. No altar dominating the central path.
Exactly two tiny generic adult expedition figures, each 1.75 m, in plain charcoal waterproof clothing with no markings, wading midway along an aisle for scale, water at knees, still showing long adult upper bodies and small heads. They occupy only about 2-3 percent of the image height. One leans to test the water with a plain staff; the other turns their head toward a side passage. No recognizable main cast, no monsters. The whole vast cathedral is the subject.
Input images 1 and 2 are APPROVED house-style references ONLY: match crisp inks, matte stone, opaque cool cel shadow shapes and carefully drawn wet reflections. Do not reproduce either room's architecture, green sky, anchor chains, floor traps, cars, electrical lamps or modern pipes. Draw the new Gothic cathedral described here. Natural water reflections only, no magical blue glow. Full resolution straight from generation; no collage, inset or labels.

No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.
images.review: Clear Gothic nave and tall rib vault; small adult figures wading at knees; deep side chapels, floating pews, attached silent bells, bronze doors and abstract rose window; pale daylight and crisp cel rendering, no text. Camera is nearer eye level than the requested high angle, allowed for an establishing location key.

Show a submerged side-passage arch at rear right, only its upper curve above water, so the route is becoming impassable. A small current pours down the entrance steps and eddies around the tombs, expressing the rise without giant waves. Empty and ominous, no people, no corpses, no monsters, no gear, no floating candles, no magic effects. Sharp black ink, broad cool shadow masses, water reflections drawn as clean horizontal irregular strokes, tombs and arch joints readable.

One or two floating broken wooden pews at frame edges. Door sill is submerged. Foreground water gives a crisp broken reflection of the pale rose and the tiny red lamp, no magical glow. Empty location, no people, no monster, no sealing stake or web yet. Nothing blocks the central door seam. Fully drawn architectural detail, hand-inked matte stone, opaque cool shadow masses.
